# Nitro Roofing & Construction

> Nitro Roofing & Construction is a family-owned roofing contractor founded in 1999 in New Bremen, Ohio. It installs and repairs residential and commercial roofs (asphalt shingle, metal, FORTIFIED, solar shingles, TPO/EPDM, coatings), gutters and siding, and helps homeowners with storm-damage insurance claims. Offices: New Knoxville (New Bremen area), Columbus and Dayton, Ohio. Phone 419-629-3624. Free roof inspections and estimates.

## Residential services
- [Roof Replacement](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/roof-replacement/): When it's time for a new roof, our GAF Master Elite® crews complete most residential roof replacements in 1–2 days, with an on-site supervisor and complete cleanup.
- [Roof Repair](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/roof-repair/): Leaks, missing shingles, flashing or storm damage, we find the root cause and fix it right the first time. Most roof repairs are completed in a single day.
- [Insurance Restoration](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/insurance-restoration/): We document every bit of storm damage, meet your adjuster on-site and handle the paperwork, so you receive the full coverage you deserve with minimal stress.
- [Storm Damage Roof Repair](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/storm-damage/): Wind, hail, heavy rain or fallen trees? We inspect fast, help with your insurance claim and restore your roof, with most repairs completed in 1–2 days.
- [Emergency Roof Repair](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/emergency-roof-repair/): Storm damage, fallen trees or sudden leaks? Our emergency team responds fast, often within hours, to tarp, weatherproof and protect your home.
- [FORTIFIED Roofing Installation](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/fortified-roofing-installation/): A FORTIFIED Roof™ goes beyond building codes with a sealed roof deck and enhanced edge protection, delivering superior storm protection and potential insurance savings.
- [Residential Metal Roofing](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/residential-roofing/metal-roofing/): Standing seam, metal shingles and ribbed panels that last 50-70 years, resist winds up to 140 mph and cut cooling costs, installed by our experienced crews.
- [Gutter Installation & Replacement](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/gutters/): Seamless gutters custom-fabricated on-site to protect your foundation, roof, siding and landscaping. Most installations are completed in a single day.
- [Siding Installation & Replacement](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/siding/): Vinyl, fiber cement, engineered wood, insulated and composite siding, plus soffit, fascia and trim, installed to protect your home and boost curb appeal.
- [Solar Roofing](https://nitroroofing.com/services/residential/solar/): Timberline Solar® Energy Shingles are nailed down like regular shingles, protecting your home like a roof while generating clean energy to lower your bills.

## Commercial services
- [Commercial Roofing](https://nitroroofing.com/services/commercial/commercial-roofing/): TPO, EPDM, PVC, modified bitumen, metal, and built-up roofing systems installed, repaired, and maintained by certified commercial specialists, with minimal disruption to your busin
- [Commercial Metal Roofing](https://nitroroofing.com/services/commercial/commercial-metal-roofing/): Standing seam, R-panel, and structural metal roofing systems that protect commercial properties for 40+ years, plus coatings and restoration for existing metal roofs.
- [All Weather Insulated Panels (AWIP)](https://nitroroofing.com/services/commercial/commercial-all-weather-insulated-panels/): All Weather Insulated Panels (AWIP) for walls and roofs: continuous insulation, structural strength, and fast installation for commercial and industrial buildings.
- [Commercial Roof Coating Systems](https://nitroroofing.com/services/commercial/roof-coating-systems/): NanoTech ICP™ roof coatings that add 10-20 years to an aging commercial roof and cut cooling costs, at a fraction of the cost of replacement.
- [Commercial Siding](https://nitroroofing.com/services/commercial/commercial-siding/): ACM panels, James Hardie fiber cement, and insulated metal panels that protect your building, lower energy costs, and shape how clients see your business.
